context: Closing recap meeting on the acquisition with management
purpose: Teach: 買収/債権/手数料/中止/ドメイン/マネジメント/廃棄/本件

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: では、本件の買収について最終確認をしておきたい。
lines.en: Well then, I'd like to do a final confirmation on this acquisition matter.
lines.style: Formal boss voice opening a serious recap meeting

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、相手企業の債権の整理もほぼ完了しております。
lines.en: Yes, the organization of the target company's claims is also nearly complete.
lines.style: Polite subordinate reporting business progress carefully

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 仲介の手数料は予定通り抑えられたのか。
lines.en: Were the brokerage fees kept down as planned?
lines.style: Sharp questioning tone, checking financial details closely

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 予算内に収まりました。古い契約の中止に伴う違約金もありません。
lines.en: It stayed within budget. There are no penalty fees from canceling old contracts either.
lines.style: Reassuring professional report with concrete reassurance offered

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: それは何よりだ。先方のドメインも我々の管理下に移ったな。
lines.en: That's a relief. Their domain has also moved under our management, correct?
lines.style: Mildly relieved senior voice confirming key handover items

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、ウェブとブランドのマネジメント体制は今週中に統合します。
lines.en: Yes, the web and brand management structure will be integrated within this week.
lines.style: Confident formal update on integration timeline progress

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 旧サーバーの廃棄処分も忘れずに進めてくれ。
lines.en: Don't forget to proceed with the disposal of the old servers as well.
lines.style: Boss giving a firm reminder about loose ends

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。来週月曜には全ての作業を完了させます。
lines.en: Understood. I will have all the work completed by next Monday.
lines.style: Crisp respectful closing commitment to the boss
